Name: Mineral Duggy Farm Cave
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url] that adds an option to the farm cave event with Demetrius, allowing him to set up the cave to spawn clay and other mineral resources including ores, crystals, etc.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
